title: Agents
description: Register the AI agents that spend from your SignetPass. You approve each one in MetaMask.

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.hint: Paste this into your coding agent. It will ask to register, and the request appears below.

approve.summary: {{agent}} wants to register with your SignetPass. Once approved it can start sessions you set limits for.
approve.missing: This registration request is no longer pending.

revoke.title: Revoke {{agent}}?
revoke.description: It can no longer start sessions or spend. Existing sessions keep their own limits until you revoke them.
